verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Discord organizes conversations into channels with threads branching off them, and that Private Threads are available for all servers. That is a first-party form of public versus private conversation spaces. However, nothing documents private channels themselves or admin membership and permission controls; roles appear only as gateway events. Missing for 10: documentation of private channels, role- or member-based channel permission controls, admin workflows for managing channel membership, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can organize conversations into public and private channels with membership controls

citations.quote: A Thread is a quick way to branch a conversation off of a channel’s main feed without removing it from the channel itself.
Private Threads are now available for all servers!
